description: Canonical recurrence, next-renewal, monthly-equivalent, forecast and validation examples for SubTrack. Normative; schema and rules in docs/api-contract.md. Fixed dates only.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: monthly clamps to month end without drift; edge-case row '€10 monthly plan anchored on January 31, 2027'
cases.description: Monthly anchor January 31, 2027 clamps to February 28 and returns to March 31.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: monthly clamps to month end without drift
cases.description: Monthly anchor January 31, 2028 clamps to February 29 in a leap year.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: monthly clamps to month end without drift
cases.description: Monthly anchor January 30 clamps only in February and keeps day 30 afterwards.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: quarterly clamps to month end without drift
cases.description: Quarterly anchor November 30 clamps to February 28 and returns to day 30.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: quarterly clamps to month end without drift
cases.description: Quarterly anchor August 31 gives November 30, February 29 (leap year), May 31, August 31.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: yearly February 29 clamps to February 28; edge-case row 'Annual anchor February 29, 2028'
cases.description: Yearly anchor February 29, 2028 gives February 28 in 2029-2031 and February 29 again in 2032.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: weekly advances in calendar days, not UTC hours
cases.description: Weekly anchor March 21, 2027 crosses the EU DST change of March 28, 2027 without shifting a day.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: every N days, N = 1 lower bound
cases.description: Every 1 day crosses the end of February 2027.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: every N days advances in calendar days from the anchor
cases.description: Every 30 days from January 15, 2027 does not follow the day of month.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: every N days, N = 366 upper bound
cases.description: Every 366 days from March 1, 2027 lands on March 1 across the leap day, then drifts a day per year.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: past anchors calculate directly from the anchor, no drift
cases.description: Monthly anchor August 31, 2019 still gives month-end dates in 2027, computed without history.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: occurrences never precede the anchor
cases.description: Weekly anchor June 9 inside a June window yields nothing before June 9.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: occurrences never precede the anchor
cases.description: An anchor after the window yields no occurrences.

cases.rule: plan §9 bounded date ranges; api-contract Date ranges: both bounds inclusive
cases.description: Occurrences exactly on from and to are included.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: next renewal is on or after today; today's occurrence stays visible
cases.description: On the billing day the next renewal is today.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: next renewal is on or after today
cases.description: The day after the billing day the next renewal moves to next month.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: today is evaluated in the user's time zone
cases.description: 2027-06-14T20:00Z is June 15 in Auckland, so the June 14 occurrence has passed.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: today is evaluated in the user's time zone
cases.description: The same instant is June 14 in Los Angeles, so the next renewal is today.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: month-end clamp applies to next renewal
cases.description: Anchor January 31: on March 1 the next renewal is March 31.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: occurrences never precede the anchor
cases.description: A future anchor is itself the next renewal.

cases.rule: plan §5 Lifecycle: cancelled excludes charges on or after the effective date; next renewal is null when none remains
cases.description: Cancellation effective June 15 removes the June 15 renewal, so there is no next renewal on June 10.

cases.rule: plan §5 Lifecycle: paused excludes occurrences during the pause; an open pause has no next renewal
cases.description: A pause without a resume date excludes every later occurrence.

cases.rule: plan §5 Lifecycle: resume requires a selected next billing date
cases.description: During a pause that resumes April 25, the next renewal is the resume date.

cases.rule: plan §5 Lifecycle: resume re-establishes the anchor
cases.description: After resuming on April 25 the schedule is re-anchored: May 25, not the original May 10.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: today is evaluated in the user's time zone; billing dates are date-only
cases.description: 21:30 UTC on March 28, 2027 is 00:30 on March 29 in Athens after the DST change (UTC+3); a stale UTC+2 offset would still say March 28.

cases.rule: plan §9 bounded date ranges; api-contract Dates: no occurrence after 2099-12-31
cases.description: The next yearly occurrence would be 2100-07-01, beyond the supported range, so there is none.

cases.rule: plan §5 Lifecycle: trial forecasts paid charges only from the first paid date
cases.description: During the trial the next renewal is the first paid date.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: schedule edits take effect on an explicit date and replace future projections
cases.description: A yearly schedule effective June 1 (anchor July 1) replaces the monthly June 15 renewal.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: yearly = amount/12; edge-case row '€120 annual plan renewing on December 15'
cases.description: €120 yearly is €10.00 a month.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: quarterly = amount/3
cases.description: €25.00 quarterly is 8.333… and rounds to €8.33.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: weekly = amount*52/12
cases.description: €5.00 weekly is 21.666… and rounds to €21.67.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: every N days = amount*365/(N*12)
cases.description: €9.99 every 30 days is 10.12875 and rounds to €10.13.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: rounding uses the currency's minor units
cases.description: ¥10000 yearly is 833.33… and rounds to ¥833 (JPY has no minor units).

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: display rounded values after summing exact contributions
cases.description: Two €10.00 quarterly items sum to 6.666… and round to €6.67, not 3.33 + 3.33 = 6.66.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: rounding is documented centrally (half away from zero)
cases.description: €0.30 yearly is exactly 0.025 and rounds half away from zero to €0.03, not banker's 0.02.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: totals are grouped by currency
cases.description: EUR and USD items give two totals sorted by currency code.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: monthly equivalent uses the price in effect today
cases.description: The €12 price effective June 1 applies on June 1.

cases.rule: plan §5 Lifecycle: a trial counts at its recurring paid price
cases.description: A trial item with no price in effect yet uses its first price.

cases.rule: plan §5 Lifecycle: paused and cancelled items have no scheduled charges; totals grouped by currency
cases.description: A paused EUR item contributes nothing but keeps a zero EUR total; the USD item cancelled before today leaves no USD total.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: schedule edits take effect on an explicit date; yearly = amount/12
cases.description: The yearly schedule version in effect today decides the factor: €120 yearly gives 10.00.

cases.rule: plan §5 Lifecycle: trial forecasts paid charges only from the first paid date; cancelled excludes charges on or after its date
cases.description: A trial cancelled effective its first paid date never charges, so it contributes 0 (no next renewal).

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: weekly = amount*52/12, every N days = amount*365/(N*12); round after summing exact contributions
cases.description: Weekly, every 7 days, quarterly and every 13 days at €10.00 sum exactly to 113.5164…, so 113.52 (rounding each item gives 113.51).

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: rounding uses the currency's minor units
cases.description: KWD has 3 minor units: 10.000 quarterly (3.3333…) plus 0.006 yearly (0.0005) gives 3.334.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: monthly equivalent of an item that has not started yet
cases.description: An active item first billed September 1 has no price in effect on June 15, so its first price (15.00) applies.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: annual charges only in their billing month; edge-case row '€120 annual plan renewing on December 15'
cases.description: €120 yearly renewing December 15 forecasts €0.00 for October.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: annual charges only in their billing month; edge-case row '€120 annual plan renewing on December 15'
cases.description: €120 yearly renewing December 15 forecasts €120.00 for December.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: apply the price effective on each date; edge-case row 'Price €10 until May 31, €12 from June 1'
cases.description: With €12 effective from June 1, the May occurrence still costs €10.00.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: apply the price effective on each date; edge-case row 'Price €10 until May 31, €12 from June 1'
cases.description: With €12 effective from June 1, the June occurrence costs €12.00.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: apply the price effective on each date (effective date <= occurrence date)
cases.description: A price effective exactly on June 20 applies to the June 20 occurrence.

cases.rule: plan §5 Lifecycle: trial forecasts paid charges only from the first paid date; edge-case row 'Free trial ends May 10, first paid charge May 11'
cases.description: Trial ends May 10 (the reminder target); the first paid charge is May 11, then monthly.

cases.rule: plan §5 Lifecycle: cancelled excludes charges on or after the effective date; edge-case row 'Cancellation effective June 15'
cases.description: Both items cancelled effective June 15: the June 14 occurrence is included, the June 15 one excluded.

cases.rule: plan §5 Lifecycle: paused excludes the pause interval; resume re-anchors on the selected date
cases.description: Paused March 1, resumed April 25: March 10 and April 10 are skipped, then the item bills on the 25th.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: totals grouped by currency; edge-case row 'EUR and USD records'
cases.description: A EUR and a USD item give two currency totals and no combined total.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: schedule edits take effect on an explicit date, preserve prior history and replace future projections
cases.description: Monthly until March, then every 14 days from April 5 (effective April 1); the old April 15 charge is gone.

cases.rule: plan §5 Lifecycle: paused excludes the pause interval; cancelled excludes charges on or after the effective date
cases.description: A cancel recorded during an open pause: only the February charge before the pause remains.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: schedule edits take effect on an explicit date; plan §5 Lifecycle: resume re-establishes the anchor
cases.description: Paused March 1 to April 25 (re-anchored on the 25th), then a weekly €3.00 schedule from June 1 replaces the June 25 charge.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: totals keep the currency's minor units
cases.description: JPY has no minor units: two 1200 JPY charges total 2400.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: totals grouped by currency; plan §5 Lifecycle: cancelled excludes charges on or after the effective date
cases.description: The only USD item was cancelled on the window start, so USD gets no total; EUR keeps its total.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: N is an integer in 1-366
cases.description: Every 0 days is out of range.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: N is an integer in 1-366
cases.description: Every 367 days is out of range.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: interval applies only to every N days
cases.description: An interval on a monthly schedule is not allowed.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: validate allowed decimal precision by currency
cases.description: EUR has 2 minor units, so 9.999 is rejected, not rounded.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: validate allowed decimal precision by currency
cases.description: JPY has 0 minor units, so 100.5 is rejected.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: ISO currency codes
cases.description: ZZZ is well-formed but not an active ISO 4217 currency.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: ISO currency codes (funds and metals excluded)
cases.description: XAU (gold) is an ISO 4217 code but metals are not supported.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: decimal-string amounts, precision validated by currency; api-contract Money: digits are counted, not values
cases.description: "9.990" in EUR has three fraction digits and is rejected, not normalized.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: decimal-string amounts, precision validated by currency; plan §9 decimal-string monetary values
cases.description: An amount sent as a JSON number is rejected.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: ISO currency codes
cases.description: A lowercase currency code is malformed.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: amounts validated centrally; plan §8 nonnegative prices; api-contract Money: amount >= 0
cases.description: A negative amount is out of range.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: decimal-string amounts, precision validated by currency; api-contract Money: at most 12 integer digits
cases.description: An amount with 13 integer digits is out of range.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: every N days needs an integer N
cases.description: everyNDays without an interval.

cases.rule: plan §9 bounded date ranges; api-contract Dates: billing dates within 1900-2099
cases.description: Billing dates before 1900-01-01 are out of range.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: ISO currency codes (funds and metals excluded)
cases.description: The WIR euro fund code CHE is not supported.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: decimal-string amounts, precision validated by currency; api-contract Money: precision is not checked when the currency is unsupported
cases.description: Only the currency is reported, because ZZZ has no known minor units.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: apply the price effective on each date; plan §8 PriceVersion: no overlapping effective ranges
cases.description: Two price versions with the same effective date.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: totals grouped by currency; one currency per item
cases.description: A later price version in another currency.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: every occurrence needs a price in effect
cases.description: The first price starts after the first billing date.

cases.rule: plan §5 Lifecycle: resume requires a selected next billing date
cases.description: A resume date on the pause date itself.

cases.rule: plan §5 Lifecycle: explicit transitions; cancellation is terminal
cases.description: No lifecycle change may follow a cancellation.

cases.rule: plan §5 Lifecycle: explicit transitions with effective dates
cases.description: After a pause that resumes April 25, the next change cannot be before April 25.

cases.rule: plan §5 Lifecycle: explicit transitions with effective dates
cases.description: A cancellation before the item's first billing date.

cases.rule: plan §5 Lifecycle: trial has an explicitly configured first paid date; edge-case row 'Free trial ends May 10, first paid charge May 11'; plan §8 TrialDetails
cases.description: The schedule must be anchored on the trial's first paid date.

cases.rule: plan §5 Lifecycle: trial is free until its end date, then the first paid date
cases.description: The trial must end before the first paid date.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: schedule edits take effect on an explicit date
cases.description: A schedule version cannot be anchored before its effective date.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: schedule edits take effect on an explicit date; plan §5 Lifecycle: resume re-establishes the anchor
cases.description: A schedule version cannot start inside a pause, where the resume would silently re-anchor it.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: schedule edits take effect on an explicit date
cases.description: schedule and scheduleVersions together: only scheduleVersions is reported, and only schedule is validated.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: every item has a billing frequency and anchor date
cases.description: Neither schedule nor scheduleVersions.

cases.rule: plan §5 Money and totals: decimal-string amounts, precision validated by currency
cases.description: An item needs at least one price version.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: schedule edits take effect on an explicit date
cases.description: scheduleVersions must not be empty.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: schedule edits take effect on an explicit date
cases.description: The first schedule version takes effect on its own anchor date.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: schedule edits take effect on an explicit date
cases.description: Schedule versions must be in ascending effective-date order.

cases.rule: plan §5 Lifecycle: explicit transitions with effective dates
cases.description: Only a cancel may follow an open pause.

cases.rule: plan §5 Lifecycle: explicit transitions with effective dates
cases.description: A cancel has no resume date.

cases.rule: plan §9 requests must never select their own owner ID
cases.description: An ownerId property is an unknown field.

cases.rule: plan §9 date-only ISO dates
cases.description: February 30 is not a date.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: every N days needs an integer N
cases.description: interval sent as a string.

cases.rule: plan §5 Supported schedules: every N days needs an integer N
cases.description: interval 30.5 is not an integer.
